advisor.input.situation.question: What situation are you assessing?
advisor.input.areas.question: What does the change touch?
advisor.value.areas.perf: A performance-sensitive path or large data
advisor.value.areas.compat: Compatibility with browsers, devices or platform versions
advisor.input.expected.question: Is the expected behavior defined?
advisor.input.impact.question: What is the worst reasonable consequence if the change fails?
advisor.value.impact.2: A feature breaks, with a workaround
advisor.value.impact.4: Data loss, a vulnerability or financial loss
advisor.input.audience.question: Who uses what will be affected?
advisor.input.reversibility.question: If the defect reached users, would it be noticed and reversed easily?
advisor.input.scope.question: How far does the change reach?
advisor.input.factors.question: Factors that raise the likelihood of a defect
advisor.value.factors.complex: Complex logic or many edge cases
advisor.value.factors.unfamiliar: Code new to me, or that I did not write
advisor.value.factors.ai_generated: Assistant-generated code I have not reviewed line by line
advisor.input.evidence.question: What tests exist around the affected area?
advisor.input.automation.question: How are the tests run?
advisor.input.flaky.question: There are flaky tests in this area
advisor.input.platform.question: Product type
advisor.input.stack.question: Technology used
advisor.input.stage.question: Project stage
advisor.input.frequency.question: How often does this part change?
advisor.input.time.question: Time available for testing now
advisor.value.migrations.yes: a migration was found or declared
advisor.value.migrations.no: no migration was found or declared
advisor.value.cause.mobile: because the product is a mobile app
advisor.value.cause.data: because the change touches stored data with a consequence of 3 or more
advisor.assume.impact: The consequence was not given, so «{impactLabel}» ({impact}) was assumed, to be safe.
advisor.assume.audience: The audience was not given, so «{audienceLabel}» was assumed.
advisor.assume.scope: The reach was not given, so «{scopeLabel}» was assumed for «{situationLabel}».
advisor.assume.evidence: The existing tests were not given, so «{evidenceLabel}» was assumed.
advisor.assume.reversibility: Reversibility was not given, so «{reversibilityLabel}» was assumed, {causeLabel}.
advisor.line.impactAudienceMe: The audience is «{audienceLabel}», so the consequence drops one step to {to}.
advisor.line.impactAuth: The change touches sign-in and permissions and the audience is «{audienceLabel}», so the consequence rises to {to}.
advisor.line.likelihoodSituation: The situation «{situationLabel}» raises the likelihood to {to}.
advisor.line.likelihoodFactors: Likelihood factors selected: {count}, so the likelihood rises by {add}.
advisor.line.likelihoodCosmetic: The situation «{situationLabel}» lowers the likelihood one step.
advisor.line.score: Risk = consequence {impactAdjusted} × likelihood {likelihood} = {score}, so the level is «{levelLabel}».
advisor.line.raised: Detection weak points ({count}) with consequence {impactAdjusted} raise the level to «{levelLabel}».
advisor.line.floor: Consequence «{impactLabel}» and audience «{audienceLabel}»: the level is at least «High».
advisor.depth.cosmeticNone: The situation «{situationLabel}» at level «{levelLabel}»: «{depthLabel}», and the items stay visible as «Optional and useful».
advisor.depth.release: Preparing a release for «{audienceLabel}»: at least «{depthLabel}».
advisor.depth.legacy: Assessing an existing project with consequence {impactAdjusted}: at least «{depthLabel}».
advisor.depth.protoCap: Stage «{stageLabel}» with consequence {impactAdjusted} below 4: depth goes no further than «{depthLabel}».
advisor.priority.depthNone: Depth «{depthLabel}»: the item stays visible as «Optional and useful», with its reason, and is not hidden.
advisor.budget.warning: The time available («{timeLabel}») cannot hold every top-priority item. Over capacity: {items}. Either postpone the merge or the delivery, or accept the risk explicitly and write down what you postponed.
advisor.fact.areaAbsent: You did not say the change touches «{areaLabel}».
advisor.md.title: A recommendation, not run: a suggested test plan
advisor.md.notRun: No test has run on your project yet. These are reasoned recommendations from the knowledge base; results come from runs, not from the advisor.
advisor.md.range: The level is between «{minLabel}» and «{maxLabel}», depending on what was not given.
advisor.md.noNewTests: Suggestion: the level is low and the evidence good and automatic, so new tests may not be needed. The items stay visible.
advisor.priority.includes: The item includes the targeted regression, so it takes that priority: «{priorityLabel}».
